messages:
sara: Kicking off region-by-region rollout for release v2.3.1. Plan: US canary -> EU canary -> APAC drip. Hold windows: US 02:00-04:00 UTC, EU 03:00-05:00 UTC, APAC 12:00-14:00 UTC. Pinning strategy: pin EU to v2.3.0 if any regressions.

mike: noted. what's the warm-pool state in each region?

ops-oncall: Warm-pool: US 150G reserved (target 120G), EU 80G (target 100G), APAC 60G (target 80G). APAC still under-provisioned by ~20%.

leo: For APAC we should enable burst autoscale for the first 30m of the drip. Also suggest using quantized-compat variant (v2.3.1-q8) as fallback if memory pressure spikes.

anita: Can we delay EU canary by 10m to let US metrics stabilize? EU has a scheduled batch job at 03:05 UTC that may skew latency.

sara: Good catch. Delay EU canary 10m. US canary start now. Deploy-bot kick it off.

deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy in US -> slice: us-west1/us-east1 (10% traffic)
```
deploy-bot: deploy id=deploy-3112234455-us-canary state=started
deploy-bot: pinned_model=v2.3.1
deploy-bot: canary_slices=[us-west1,us-east1]
deploy-bot: traffic_split=10%
```

mike: US canary warmed up. Observability: 95th latency = 120ms, error rate = 0.6%, GPU reserved jumped to 89%. Token throughput stable.

ops-oncall: Alert rule: if sustained error rate > 3% over 5m OR 95th latency > 200ms -> rollback. Also if GPU reservation > 95% for >10m, throttle new canaries.

leo: I'm seeing a small regression in a prompt family (long-context summarization) in US. Delta BLEU-ish metric dropping ~4%. Not a blocker but flagging.

anita: EU bump postponed to 10m. I'll validate release notes and safe prompts to run as smoke set. Can someone post the smoke set?

mike: Posting smoke set in thread: [link] :point_up: running now.

deploy-bot: US canary traffic 10% -> evaluating metrics (5m windows)
```
deploy-bot: canary_metrics={"latency_p95_ms":118, "err_rate_pct":0.7, "throughput_tps":420}
```

leo: Given the long-context regression, propose to add a canary evaluation: run 200 synthetic long-context queries from smoke set and compare outputs to baseline. If quality delta > 6% then hold/rollback.

sara: Agreed. Run that now on the canary instances. Mike coordinate. Anita prepare fallback notes for EU pin to v2.3.0.

mike: Kickoff synthetic run. Initial samples done: 200/200 queued. Expected finish in ~3m.

ops-oncall: APAC capacity: still low. If we push APAC drip now it will immediately hit auto-eviction. Recommend hold APAC until warm-pool >=75G or we have burst enabled.

deploy-bot: Synthetic long-context eval completed: 200 samples, quality_drop_pct=4.9% -> within threshold (hold threshold 6%).

leo: OK — within threshold. Proceed with EU canary in 5m (we delayed 10m earlier; now metrics stable). Remember EU pin fallback plan ready.

anita: EU pinned rollout config: if any of [err_rate>2%, latency_p95>220ms, quality_drop>6%] then pin EU to v2.3.0 and open incident channel #inc-rollback-eu. Release notes updated with known long-context regression and mitigation steps.

sara: EU canary go. deploy-bot please start EU slices (eu-west1, eu-central1) at 8% traffic.

deploy-bot: Starting canary deploy in EU -> slices: eu-west1/eu-central1 (8% traffic)
```
deploy-bot: deploy id=deploy-3112234455-eu-canary state=started
deploy-bot: pinned_model=v2.3.1
deploy-bot: traffic_split=8%
```

mike: EU canary warmup: latency p95=135ms, err rate=0.4%, GPU reserve=82%. Smoke set eval starting.

anita: Running smoke set on EU canary. Will post results.

deploy-bot: EU canary smoke eval complete: 150 samples, quality_drop_pct=2.1%, err_rate_avg=0.5%

sara: EU looks healthy. Prepare APAC drip but do not start until ops-oncall confirms warm-pool bump or we enable burst. Decision gate: APAC start only if warm-pool >=75G or ops confirms burst enabled.

ops-oncall: I can enable burst autoscale for 30m starting +2m from now. That should cover the initial drip. Enabling now.

mike: Once burst is enabled I recommend a very slow drip: start 2% traffic, increase by 2% every 10m. Monitor GPU reserve and latency.

leo: Also set a fallback routing policy to route APAC traffic to the q8 quant variant if GPU reserve > 92% or latency > 250ms.

deploy-bot: APAC burst autoscale enabled. Starting drip: ap-southeast1/ap-northeast1 -> initial 2% traffic
```
deploy-bot: deploy id=deploy-3112234455-apac-drip state=started
deploy-bot: initial_traffic=2% next_step=+2%/10m
```

mike: APAC first-step metrics: latency p95=180ms, err rate=0.9%, GPU reserve=78%. Good to step to 4% in 10m.

anita: I'll monitor release notes channel and prepare the rollback PR if EU needs pin. Also prepping customer comms draft in case of wider rollback.

sara: Summaries/decision points: 1) US canary passed metrics; long-context regression small but below threshold. 2) EU canary healthy. 3) APAC drip proceeding under burst autoscale, slow increments. 4) Rollback triggers: err_rate>3% sustained 5m OR p95>220ms OR quality_drop>6%. If triggered, pin region to v2.3.0 and open incident.

leo: I'll keep an eye on the long-context baseline; follow-up patch planned if regression persists after scale.

ops-oncall: I'll watch GPU reservation and revoke burst if thermal/eviction risk rises.

sara: Thanks team. Hold on handoff channel for any immediate rollbacks. If nothing else, we'll kick rollout to full traffic in US in 90m and then ramp EU/APAC accordingly. :thumbsup:
